opening.text: Okay... suit's holding. That's a start. Hang on. Is that a light over there?

lights.text: Oh, wow. Someone built a whole gym out here.

machine.text: Uh... was that there a second ago?

robot.text: Oh, hey. Give me a second. It's been quiet around here.

greeting.text: I'm Orbit. So... you found my gym. Want the quick tour?

guide.text: Pick something you'd like to work on. I'll meet you there.

tour-review.text: Bring me a clip from whichever angle you've got. I'll tell you what I can see, and what I'd need another look at.

tour-missions.text: Have a look through the feedback, then finish and step back into the park. That's when I log your activity. No rush.

tour-energy.text: Your practice keeps the lights on. That's our story, anyway. Five activity days earn twenty energy credits. The missions tab has the details.

tour-settings.text: Too loud? Too much movement? Settings is up there. Your journal keeps this visit's clips and notes. You can delete them whenever you like.

tour-play.text: And those little consoles? They're for a break. Try the lights, the memory board, or the orbit dial. Just for fun. They don't count as a workout.

analysis-start.text: Got it. Let me watch that through.

analysis-ready.text: Okay, I've marked a few moments. Tap a time and we'll look at that bit.

analysis-partial.text: I can see some of it. Let's look at those bits first. I've put down what would help me see the rest.

analysis-insufficient.text: I'm not getting a clear view of you here. Check the recording tips below. We can try again.

first-review.text: There you go. First one done. Your notes are in the journal if you want another look later.
